results.operating_point: builtin-heuristic native verdict (analyze_text); no score threshold
results.method: Independent reproduction of Worker B's DetectRL-X expanded-sample evaluation: raw source file verified by size + SHA-256, re-streamed once with the frozen strided sample and re-mapped; normalised caches verified by SHA-256 and row-by-row against the fresh mapping; inspection block re-derived; near-duplicate components and the language-stratified 60/20/20 partition re-derived and compared per-row against the frozen manifests; detector re-run fresh at its native operating point; every slice recomputed with Worker B's exact conventions (one shared Random(20261116) stream in the fixed call order, row bootstrap via randrange, cluster bootstrap via choice, Wilson FPR/TPR from my own formula implementation). AUROC cross-checked pairwise vs rank form. No tuning on the final holdout.

identity_checks.check: cache train-w8.jsonl sha256 matches its manifest
cache train-w8.jsonl sha256 matches artifact provenance
cache train-w8.jsonl rows identical to fresh mapping
cache test-w8.jsonl sha256 matches its manifest
cache test-w8.jsonl sha256 matches artifact provenance
cache test-w8.jsonl rows identical to fresh mapping
manifest fit covers exactly its rows
manifest validation covers exactly its rows
manifest final-test covers exactly its rows

inspection.sampling: strided (sample_offsets over 76800 train + 48000 test rows); deterministic, no randomness

near_duplicates.method: union-find over shared human-text identity plus word-8-shingle Jaccard >= 0.8 (exact verification; crc32 index proposes candidates only). Cross-language near-dup pairs are covered by the same global index; the shared-human-text check additionally catches train/test overlap of the underlying human texts.

partition.method: whole components, stratified by language, deterministic hash order, greedy 60/20/20 by row count; partition uses text identity only, frozen before evaluation

notes: Independent reproduction of Worker B's DetectRL-X expanded-sample evaluation. Every compared field either agrees exactly or is listed in 'discrepancies'. Reproduction verdict: AGREE. Pooled as re-measured here: human FPR 0/12000 (Wilson 95% [0.0, 0.00032]), native TPR 0/12000, AUROC 0.5961 (bootstrap 95% CI [0.5884, 0.603]); final-test human FPR 0/2400 (Wilson 95% [0.0, 0.001598]), native TPR 0/2400, AUROC 0.5994.
